Implemented [ContactForm.tsx](/workspace/app/ContactForm.tsx) with an inline `'use server'` action, labeled name/email/message fields, and a submit button.

Server validation rejects missing, empty, whitespace-only, and non-text values. Valid submissions are logged on the server, matching the existing simulated-save pattern.

Verified with a successful production build and checks covering valid submission plus 13 invalid cases.
